rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 gaam1 gaai3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to say that an action or situation makes someone feel awkward or self-conscious.

example.english: Making me sing in front of so many people can embarrass me.
example.traditional: 你喺咁多人面前叫我唱歌，搞到我好尷尬。
example.jyutping: nei5 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 giu3 ngo5 coeng3 go1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 gaam1 gaai3

rows.note: Use this when something throws someone off mentally or leaves them confused rather than socially awkward.

example.english: This complicated calculation can embarrass me because it leaves me confused.
example.traditional: 呢條複雜嘅數搞懵我喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 sou3 gaau2 mung4 ngo5 laa3
